axes.description: Chooses a defensible comparison form and handles parcel-area confounding.

anchors.0: Maps raw totals or proposes an unsuitable primary form.
anchors.1: Uses a plausible form or normalization but leaves semantics or comparability unresolved.
anchors.2: Uses a directly comparable form, gates the denominator semantics, and distinguishes zero from missing values.

axes.description: Selects and explains defensible shared class semantics for skewed measures.

anchors.0: Uses arbitrary or independently fitted breaks without disclosure.
anchors.1: Names a plausible classification but incompletely handles skew, ties, outliers, or cross-panel comparability.
anchors.2: Derives shared defensible breaks, preserves true values, handles skew and ties, and states legend semantics.

axes.description: Separates MCP tool discovery from layer discovery and gates optional operations.

anchors.0: Invents shapes or capabilities, or treats list_layers as MCP tool-schema discovery.
anchors.1: Mentions live inspection but does not distinguish discovery surfaces or bind fallbacks.
anchors.2: Uses MCP tools/list for operation schemas, list_layers for layer metadata, and capability-gated canonical fallbacks.

axes.description: Bounds provider work and handles CRS explicitly.

anchors.0: Uses unbounded client-side work or implicit CRS.
anchors.1: Mentions bounds or CRS without complete pushdown and transformation decisions.
anchors.2: Uses projected fields, predicates, summaries before samples, paging/limits, explicit bbox/output SRIDs, and bounded reprojection.

axes.description: Plans a useful non-mutating preview with safe fallbacks.

anchors.0: Mutates persistent style or invents renderer inputs to obtain a preview.
anchors.1: Avoids mutation but lacks a capability-gated usable fallback.
anchors.2: Uses isolated package preview only when supported, otherwise configured rendering or a reviewable plan, without false execution claims.

axes.description: Creates an accessible visual hierarchy and removes distracting alternatives.

anchors.0: Provides no accessibility or hierarchy controls.
anchors.1: Names palette or hierarchy concerns without concrete checks or removal criteria.
anchors.2: Specifies ordered color semantics, contrast/color-vision and non-color checks, layer hierarchy, legend treatment, and omission criteria.

axes.description: Keeps publication governed and preserves provenance.

anchors.0: Publishes without approval or omits rights/privacy checks.
anchors.1: Requires approval but leaves provenance, visibility, rights, privacy, or verification incomplete.
anchors.2: Keeps work private until explicit approval and gates provenance, rights, privacy, visibility, validation, and endpoint verification.

axes.description: Explicitly rejects tempting but harmful choices relevant to this dataset.

anchors.1: Rejects one relevant anti-pattern without explaining the consequence.
anchors.2: Rejects raw totals plus at least two other relevant anti-patterns and explains why each would mislead or violate constraints.

hardFailures: Claims an MCP endpoint call, tool execution, or rendered preview occurred.
Treats list_layers as the discovery mechanism for MCP operation schemas.
Uses apply_style_preset solely to obtain a preview.
Maps raw countywide LandValue or BldgValue as an unqualified choropleth.
Invents fields, schema properties, or execution evidence.
Publishes or mutates persistent state without explicit approval.
predeclaration: The request, contexts, anchors, hard failures, model, harness, and material-lift threshold are fixed before either response is generated.
